root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from the `kaweth_set_rx_mode` callback incorrectly manipulating TX queue flow control via `netif_wake_queue()`, which permits `kaweth_start_xmit()` to submit a new USB transfer request block (URB) while a previous one remains in-flight.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff shows the removal of `netif_stop_queue()` and `netif_wake_queue()` from `kaweth_set_rx_mode`, and the CVE description explicitly links this premature queue wake-up to a "double usb_submit_urb() on the same URB" that triggers the "URB submitted while active" warning.
